title: Coproduct
description: JSON Schema for a coproduct — the universal cocone over a discrete diagram (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3; Awodey 2010 §5.1). Dual to product. A coproduct of objects A_1, ..., A_n consists of an object C together with injection morphisms ι_i : A_i → C such that any other object Q with morphisms q_i : A_i → Q factors uniquely through C. Uses oneOf to distinguish binary from n-ary cases.

cofactors.description: The objects A_1, ..., A_n being summed.

injections.description: The injection morphisms ι_i : A_i → C, one per cofactor.

coproduct-object.description: The coproduct object C = A_1 + ... + A_n.
